Amiable Beloved
Can dear Eyes feel great hope in joy kindling lonely Margaretta’s notions of procuring quarters reposefully secure through united votes with xpressed youthful zeal - ?

The alphabet will not serve me to express that I never gave [you](/person/749) the direction to the lady who will try to get votes for [Miss Erle](/person/2010), and here it is.[^1] [Mamma](/person/1606) is very well and bright.

The Chair is to be sent for to be inspected at home
your affectionate

C M Yonge
The address is
[Miss Carter Smith](/person/263)
8 Wellington Road
Charlton


[^1]: Jacob is evidently seeking the admission of Miss Erle, whose first name was presumably Margaretta or Margaret, to a home for incurables. CMY had a subscriber\'s vote at the [Royal Hospital for Incurables](/organisation/37), but the [Home for Incurable and Infirm Women](/organisation/26) is another possibility.
